run_PointRend_training: run the PointRend training script with a config file and optional command line arguments
run_PointRend_evaluation: run the PointRend model evaluation only mode using a config file and pre-trained weights
build_sem_seg_train_aug: build semantic segmentation training augmentations including resize, crop, color augmentation, and random flip
build_Trainer_evaluator: build an evaluator for LVIS, COCO, semantic segmentation, or Cityscapes datasets by dataset name
build_Trainer_train_loader: build a training data loader with optional semantic segmentation augmentations for the given config
